verses.pali: “Nava, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without giving up nine things you can’t realize perfection.

verses.pali: Rāgaṁ, dosaṁ, mohaṁ, kodhaṁ, upanāhaṁ, makkhaṁ, paḷāsaṁ, issaṁ, macchariyaṁ—
verses.english: Greed, hate, delusion, anger, acrimony, disdain, contempt, jealousy, and stinginess.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, nava dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: Without giving up these nine things you can’t realize perfection.

verses.pali: Nava, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: After giving up nine things you can realize perfection.

verses.pali: Rāgaṁ, dosaṁ, mohaṁ, kodhaṁ, upanāhaṁ, makkhaṁ, paḷāsaṁ, issaṁ, macchariyaṁ—
verses.english: Greed, hate, delusion, anger, acrimony, disdain, contempt, jealousy, and stinginess.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, nava dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātun”ti.
verses.english: After giving up these nine things you can realize the fruit of perfection.”
